trail.text: Investigating the latency surge — mapping the blast radius to find the source.
The initial sweep points to travel as the epicenter — now digging into timing and dependencies to separate cause from victims.
Early timing hints at an upstream trigger — now checking underlying data stores and related services for the true origin.
Leaf services show the earliest degradation — now ruling out infrastructure contention before finalizing the ranking.

causes.reasoning: Earliest latency degradation (first exceed 7s, 0.03->0.52s 17x) with p50 unchanged, indicating leaf-service tail fault that propagates to aggregators.
Second-earliest tail degradation (first exceed 12s, 0.037->0.66s 17x) with p50 unchanged, parallel leaf co-affected and amplifying upstream.
Aggregator median explodes 0.13->2.57s from 36s (after route/train), consistent with victim summing downstream route+train delays; memory failures spike later as consequence.
Caller of travel rises 0.27->3.44s from 26s and flatlines at 3.75s timeout, classic victim saturation.
Edge dashboard latency 0.43->3.88s from 17s plus new errors, victim of downstream travel/route/train slowdown with reduced throughput.
